result.instruction: Keep the `pwm` interface and synchronous active-high reset behavior, and retain the registered `pwm_out <= (counter < duty)` behavior. Replace the counter’s terminal-count branch and `counter + 1` update with an 8-bit counter whose bit 0 toggles each active cycle and whose bit *i* toggles when all lower counter bits are 1, so it wraps naturally from 255 to 0; clear it on reset.
